name: Non-linear Algebraic Obfuscation
description: Replaces the boolean logical clause "not both rigid" with a non-linear polynomial inequality $v_1 + v_2 + v_1 v_2 \le 0$ over the domain $\{-1, 1\}$. This forces the model to algebraically evaluate the function over its discrete domain to rediscover the forbidden state $(1, 1)$, preventing simple pattern-matching of 2-SAT logical disjunctions.
